name: Mr. Bones & Co.
neighborhoods: Greater NYC-based (Manhattan mailing) + Hudson Valley; adopts NY/NJ/CT
notes:
501(c)(3) since 2013, volunteer-based, greater NYC + Hudson Valley. Signature 'One Lucky Pup' program takes dogs facing EXTRAORDINARY challenges - complex medical, traumatic injury, behavioral, breed discrimination, or no other path out of municipal shelters. Individualized care per dog for complex medical and behavior cases. Foster-based (needs NY/CT/NJ foster homes). Fee $500 (covers surgery/specialty care, vaccines, s/n, microchip, foster costs). Also funds grants + s/n events. Phone: (no public phone; email preferred) Intake: online application

takes senior and complex-medical dogs case-by-case within its individualized-care program. info@mrbonesandco.org, mrbonesandco.org.
